Boca Raton Real Estate

Welcome to Boca Raton, Florida, a vibrant gem nestled in the heart of Palm Beach County. Known for its stunning beaches, luxurious lifestyle, and rich cultural scene, Boca Raton offers an unparalleled living experience that combines the best of coastal living with urban sophistication.

Boca Raton boasts a warm, inviting climate year-round, making it an ideal destination for those who enjoy outdoor activities. With miles of pristine shoreline, residents can indulge in sun-soaked days at the beach, partake in water sports, or simply unwind with a good book by the ocean. The city is also home to several beautiful parks and nature preserves, perfect for hiking, biking, or enjoying a leisurely picnic.

Culturally, Boca Raton is a hub of artistic expression and community engagement. The city is home to the renowned Boca Raton Museum of Art, which showcases an impressive collection of contemporary works, as well as the Mizner Park Amphitheater, where residents can enjoy concerts and events throughout the year. Dining enthusiasts will delight in the diverse culinary scene, featuring everything from upscale restaurants to charming cafes, ensuring there's something to satisfy every palate.

Boca Raton's real estate market is as diverse as its community, offering a range of options from luxurious waterfront estates to charming single-family homes and modern condominiums. With top-rated schools, a strong sense of community, and a wealth of amenities, it’s no wonder that Boca Raton is a sought-after destination for families, retirees, and professionals alike.

Experience the allure of Boca Raton—where coastal charm meets urban elegance. Discover your dream home in this enchanting city today!

FULL IMPACT DOORS & WINDOWS!! Welcome to this beautiful, move in ready 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom villa located in the highly desirable 55+ community of Town Villas in Boca Raton. This residence combines modern upgrades, comfort, and peace of mind in one of Boca Raton's most convenient active adult locations. Enjoy true Florida indoor outdoor living with both a screened in covered front patio and a screened in rear patio. Additional highlights include ALL IMPACT doors and windows for enhanced safety, storm protection, and energy efficiency, a 1 car garage, in unit washer and dryer, and upgraded light fixtures and ceiling fans throughout. Step inside to a bright and open floor plan featuring fresh interior paint, modern finishes, and a seamless flow between the living and dining areas ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Throughout the main living area, you will find high quality large format tile flooring with a white finish and elegant marble like veining that adds a clean and sophisticated touch. The kitchen is a true showpiece and masterclass in modern efficient design, blending high tech convenience with a clean monochromatic aesthetic. Fully renovated and thoughtfully designed, it features a premium stainless steel appliance package including a Samsung smart refrigerator with touchscreen display, a stainless steel double oven, stainless steel dishwasher, and a matching over the range microwave. Crisp white cabinetry, pristine stone countertops, and a sleek minimalist backsplash create a bright contemporary feel, while modern pendant lighting and large format tile flooring complete the space with a polished upscale finish. The spacious primary suite offers a relaxing retreat with a generous closet featuring a California Closet organization system, along with an ensuite bathroom complete with a walk in shower and separate vanity. The 2nd bedroom offers excellent flexibility for guests, a home office, or additional living space and is conveniently connected to the guest bathroom. Residents of Town Villas enjoy a well maintained and active 55+ lifestyle community featuring a welcoming clubhouse and resort style amenities designed for social living, recreation, and relaxation. The community offers a vibrant atmosphere with planned activities and gathering spaces that foster connection and convenience right outside your door. Ideally located in Boca Raton, this home is just minutes from world class shopping, dining, and entertainment including Town Center at Boca Raton, Mizner Park, and a wide selection of local restaurants and cafés. Nearby parks, walking paths, and golf courses offer endless outdoor recreation, while easy access to major roadways keeps everything South Florida has to offer within reach.
